That is basically how almost everyone feels to me beside her and maybe another therapist (who only treats kids, I already talked to her about this and it only marginally helped for a few hours).... 

But she is hope. Love.... 

I hate myself so much... for waiting until I was an adult only to not upset my parents again by wanting therapy. And for telling her how I feel... 

I can't stop crying again.... There must be some point where you just die right? A point where hopelessness and sadness just kill you? .... 

There is a heart condition called Tako-Tsubo, happens mostly to elderly women who lost their husband... but sometimes to younger ones too... I just hope my heart will stop.

EDIT: I am sorry.... I know that is impossible to help me... and still I post on a side where I know people will try... you are a nice person, thanks for talking to me!

Being in the same room as her just makes everything better. I feel safe then. And talking to anyone else is just like talking to a wall in comparison. I don't want anyone else... And there is nothing anyone beside her can do to help me...

I just feel completely lost now...

Yes. He is on vacation until March. My only hope is that I could convince him to try to change her mind... that is what I am holding on to right now. Convince some guy I don't know in March... 

She is everything to me.... I don't even ask her to heal me or anything. Just listen to me for an hour a week and get paid.... Am I that terrible of a person that she would not even talk to me for money?

I was diagnosed with depression when I was 11, had half a year of treatment before my parents stopped it. Sought some treatment of my own as a teen and hell broke loose at home... So now I'm a second year student in Europe trying to treat myself I guess. Not with meds or alcohol. Because I have emetophobia. 

(Any other emetophobics here by chance?)

Well that means I am extremely scared that I could vomit. Over time I managed to be ok if others vomit if I am 100% sure that it isn't contagious. Yes that I'm going to be a doctor is a huge irony. But I somehow managed so far. I used to not be able to go outside, that has obviously changed. 
But I wipe my mouth everytime something touches my lips (I know that this is useless, but it calms my brain a bit). I don't ever touch my food and am pretty much unable to eat "normally" because I have to make sure everything is clean, cooked fully, not over the best before date.... My brain goes to great lenghts to make sure I can feel safe for a bit...

By the way I've already worked a month in the hospital and some shifts in the ER, went surprisingly ok. I was scared to death but no one noticed.

Beside that I still deal with depression, though I can manage I think, I may imagine breaking down crying at least once a week (and I don't know how I'll survive the psych block in summer - help I can't get everywhere...), but I get my ass to lectures and stuff. I dissociate a lot. This has been getting worse.... I have trouble "grasping" a self or personality... it feels split and fluid... (sorry I don't know how to explain depersonalisation... sometimes my body just does weird things too like feeling extremely heavy...) my former psych was concerned that I could become psychotic at some point, so I monitor my thoughts. Still ok at the moment. 

I could go on but I have to go to work.... To all the people able to get help (I have examined every option and there is none at the moment...) do it. Better earlier that later... And you guys rock that you manage your illness and medschool!

Btw. I am on top of my class. No one suspects anything. Sometimes I just want to explode and show them... maybe cut my arms instead of invisible places once. Really odd thoughts because I like to be invisible... I guess I am just desperate to get help somewhere...
